chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Sindī, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Shuʿayb, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who finds semen on his garment, while not knowing that he had experienced a wet dream. He said: “Let him wash whatever he finds on his garment and perform wudu (ablution).”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the authority giving the ruling
key_terms.لِيَغْسِلْ: let him wash the affected area

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he finds semen on his clothing but did not know he had experienced a wet dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who finds semen on his garment without having known that he experienced a wet dream. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to wash the affected part of the garment and to perform wudu (ablution).
